book.name: Suun
book.title: Mɓe ɗe Jesu Kristi woo nJoon ndǝǝn Suun

content: Daa mo pwoovǝl mǝ tuup Naan
Ɗangɓe nghan kǝlǝng mee ɗoo ɗeɓal nɗǝǝn Lu Naan ɗeɗes nǝ, nǝ sat nenlep kǝ Naan ɗe pwoovǝl nǝ mo nǝnee, <<Wu dǝm wu ɗoo mbii ɗe ndǝǝn ɗaa shool ɗe pwoovǝl ɗi mǝ tuup Naan nǝ mo nkaa yil ne.>>

Ngulep Naan ɗinshee wur dǝm ɗoo mbii ɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa shool ɗe wur kǝ nǝ nkaa yil nǝ. Ɗangɓe sǝrep ɗeshwal ɗe mo bish naa, mo pwas nen ɗe mo kǝ fili (alaama) mǝ luwa nkaa sut sǝ, kǝ nen ɗe ɗi mo seyil mmuriin kǝ luwa ne.
Ngulep Naan ɗevǝl wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝ nǝ nkaa baahar, ɗangɓe am nǝ cǝǝr ɗee kaa toom kǝ ngu mumuut sǝ. Mɓe ɗe mo kǝ seen ɗe moo tong nɗǝǝn am, mo murap jir.
Ngulep Naan ɗekun, wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝ nǝ nkaa gǝnǝ am mo, kǝ tuɓut mo. Am nǝ mo cǝǝr ɗee a toom.
Wen kǝlǝng ngulep ɗe wur tap kǝ am mo, wur sat nǝnee,

content.text: waa ɗe gyet yam, ɓǝ waa ɗǝ,
kǝ toom nensatpwoo fwa mo zak,
mo shwaa ntiit-ntiit kǝ kwat mo.>>
a peewus mbezuum nǝ sat zak nǝnee,
Azeen-nzeen, canɗyeel fwa nǝ mo azeen,

content: Ngulep Naan ɗefeer, wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝ nǝ, nkaa puus. Ɗangɓe mo cínɓal mpuus nǝ, mbǝkǝ nǝ caan gurum mo ɗe shi wus.
Tal kǝ puus nǝ fes ɓaan gurum mo, shiɓal, mbe mo satpwoo ɗebuu nkaa sǝm kǝ Naan, ɗe wur kǝ iiko nkaa jeel nǝ mo. Mbe mo chi tuwap, baa mo kwoop ɗeɗes Naan kas.
Ngulep Naan ɗepaat, wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝ nǝ, nkaa pee mǝ mulki mǝ luwa nǝ. Ɗangɓe mulki kǝ luwa nǝ cǝǝr ɗee a peenkoo. Ɓe gurum mo ǝrap liis fur mo mbǝ jeel ɗe mo nkaa shwaa ne.
Gurum mo waa satpwoo ɗebuu nkaa Naan, mbǝ shwaajeel ɗe mo nkaa shwaa nǝ, kǝ sǝrap mo mo zak, mɓe jir kǝse, ɓe mo chi tuwap, mbǝ ɗak ɗebish ɗe mo kǝ ten cin mo.
Ngulep Naan ɗepeemee, wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝni, nkaa gǝnǝ Yufrates ɗeɗes sǝ, ɓe am ɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn gǝnǝ ɗesǝ nǝ ɗel fii, mbǝkǝ nǝ ɗak ar ɗe mishkoom ɗe mo njì nkoop puus kǝkàa.
Ɗangɓe nghan naa riin ɗebish mo kun, ɗe mo kaa nzargook mo sǝ, mo jì put nɗǝǝn pwoo kǝ kus nwòo sǝ, kǝ nɗǝǝn pwoo kǝ luwa sǝ, kǝ nɗǝǝn pwoo kǝ ngusatpwoo Naan mǝ ɗung sǝ.
Riin ɗebish ɗesǝ nǝ mo nkaa cin mbǝ aapwoo mo ɗes hakyeng. Mo dǝm pee mishkoom mǝ yil ɗesǝ mo jir, mbǝkǝ mo kyak mo le ɗe ashak mbǝ cin lek parpuus ɗeɗes mǝ Naan ɗeɓal met jir sǝ.
<<Wu naa nghan njì a kaa wat sǝ! Nen ɗe mo tong shi gongpee, ɗe mo kǝ lée fur mo a lǝlep, mbǝkǝ taji mo put ngum, kǝ mo kat naashwoop ɗe kas, ɓe nen mǝnǝ mo nkat ɗeret.>>
Riin ɗebish ɗesǝ nǝ mo kyak mishkoom mǝ yil ɗesǝ mo le ashak, mmee mɓeɗǝ moo pet nǝ shi lespwoo mǝ nen Yahudi mo a Armageddon.
Ngulep ɗepwoovǝl, wur dǝm ɗoo mbǝɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn ɗaa ɗe wur kǝnǝ nkaa kut. Ɗang mee ɗoo ɗeɓal jì put nɗǝǝn Lu kǝ Naan ɗǝɗes, a peetong mǝ mulki nǝ nǝnee, <<Nǝ kǝ shin!>>
Kǝzak, pee nǝ mǝlep, nluupet, kǝ pee nǝ gwan. Yil nǝ yoon shiɓal, ɗe baa yil kǝ kyam yoon kaa mǝnǝ sǝ kas, pǝgyet ɗe gurum mo yaa tong ɗe ndǝǝn yil ne.
Bǝrnǝn ɗeɗes nǝ ɓàk kun, kǝ kaar yil ɗe ndǝǝn yil nǝ mo jir, mo shirip. Naan wur pan Babilon ɗeɗes sǝ, mbe wur cin kap ɗe nǝ gam kǝ am anab (filip) ɗe nǝ a mǝ tuup wur nwura shwaa.
Koo rep laayil ɗeɗangyi ɗe am neer nǝ cǝǝrkaat, ɓe nǝ su dǝm loom, kǝ ɗengjwak mo su dǝm laam zak.

Ɗaar ɗǝnan-nan mo put nɗengnaan, mbe mo sham taa nkaa gurum mo, koo a ɗaar ɗeɗangyi ɓe toon kǝ nǝ wul kaa mǝ bufu kǝǝn sǝ. Gurum mo satpwoo ɗebuu nkaa Naan, mbǝ shwal ɗe moo shwaa nǝ, mbǝ sham kǝ ɗaar ɗesǝ nǝ mo, kǝ zak, mɓeeɗe jeel nǝ fes shwal zam hakyeng.
